name: External database access restriction
description: EXT-ATK tries TCP/3306 on DB-SRV. FW1 does not publish it and denies it.

presentation.objective: Show that the perimeter keeps the database private.
presentation.security_rule: FW1 OUTSIDE-IN: no rule permits tcp 3306, so the implicit deny applies.
presentation.explanation: The SYN reaches FW1 and is denied there; it never enters the campus. This is a firewall decision, not an IDS or IPS one, and IDS-1 cannot see the packet because it never reached the core.
expected: The SYN is dropped at FW1 (OUTSIDE-IN implicit deny)
The traffic never reaches CORE-SW1, IPS-1 or DB-SRV
The SIEM receives an FW1 enforcement event
No IDS or IPS alert is raised
